name: universe
description: Unified Conda recipe builder, binary auditor, CEP-15/16 channel indexer, and docs portal generator

scripts.all:check: bun x --bun turbo run fmt-check lint typecheck test && bun x --bun biome format package.json biome.json turbo.json tsconfig.json && bun x --bun biome check package.json biome.json turbo.json tsconfig.json
scripts.all:lint: bun x --bun turbo run lint && bun x --bun biome check package.json biome.json turbo.json tsconfig.json
scripts.all:fmt: bun x --bun turbo run fmt && bun x --bun biome check --write package.json biome.json turbo.json tsconfig.json
scripts.all:fmt-check: bun x --bun turbo run fmt-check && bun x --bun biome format package.json biome.json turbo.json tsconfig.json
